# mcp-facturacion-electronica-es

> MCP server for Spanish electronic invoicing (VERI*FACTU, Facturae/FACe, SII, Crea y Crece B2B)

## Docs

- [Overview](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-facturacion-electronica-es/): the full README — what this server does, installation, configuration, available tools
- [Tools](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-facturacion-electronica-es/tools/): full MCP tool reference
- [Changelog](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-facturacion-electronica-es/changelog/): version history
- [Contributing](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-facturacion-electronica-es/contributing/): dev setup and PR checklist
- [Security](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-facturacion-electronica-es/security/): vulnerability disclosure policy
